annotations.title: Audit your x402 / MPP paid API listing: will agents find it, see the price and complete a paid call?

description: For sellers of paid APIs. Reads the public listing of the origin you name (openapi.json, /.well-known/x402, llms.txt, up to 3 unpaid calls that should answer 402) and returns a 0-100 score, ranked fixes with the reason each one costs sales, per-operation issues (missing schemas, generic operationIds, required inputs without examples that make blind paid calls fail) and 402 checks (400 before 402, payTo checksum, network names, price mismatch, bazaar metadata). Optional task = what buyers ask for. Deterministic; origin "sample" audits a built-in example. An origin that does not answer is not charged. PAID: $0.040 per call in USDC on Base via x402 over MCP, or from prepaid credits if this server is configured with an Authorization: Bearer tkc_... header (see payment_options).

origin.description: Host of the paid API to audit, e.g. api.example.com or https://api.example.com/v1/tool (a path is probed first). "sample" = a built-in example listing (no network request).

task.description: Optional: what a buyer would ask a router for, in their words (max 160 characters), e.g. "split text into an X thread"; the report shows which operation matches it best and which words are missing.
